//: REQUIRED for Sdk="DotKt.Sdk.Mpp": the Mpp SDK imports the base DotKt.Sdk via a version-LESS nested import, and the NuGet MSBuild-SDK resolver reads a nested SDK's version ONLY from this msbuild-sdks map (it ignores the nuspec dependency and any inline Sdk="Name/Version"). Both must be pinned to the same version — tracks the packed local SDK version (packaging/DotKt.Versions.props), mirroring the inline pins in the sibling consumer/producer .ktproj files. This global.json lives in the producer-mpp subtree ONLY, so it cannot affect any sibling test project (SDK resolution never searches downward or across siblings).
